Register the MCP server, install the skill, and optionally add a Stop hook for Claude Code

## Usage

    gournal setup claude [options]

## Options

| Option | Description | Default |
|--------|-------------|---------|
| `--uninstall` | Remove what setup added |  |
| `-y, --yes` | Apply the MCP and skill steps without asking |  |
| `--hook` | Also add the Stop hook that reminds Claude to log work |  |
